name: onepiecepower.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 7007 images have no alt attribute.
lesson: Describe what each image shows in its alt attribute, and use alt="" on purely decorative ones.
summary: onepiecepower.com scores 66 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 36 are at risk, and 33 pass. Fix first: 7007 images have no alt attribute.

fix.title: 7007 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 35 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /php/loginRegister, /vip/vip_page, /anime18/lista-anime2 and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 22 elements on /, /php/loginRegister, /vip/home, for example div:nth-child(2) > a:nth-child(1) > div > span and div:nth-child(2) > a:nth-child(2) > div > span. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 1 cookie is sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: PHPSESSID. Without HttpOnly: PHPSESSID. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /php/loginRegister, /vip/vip_page and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
The start page declares its language
Nothing on the page blocks the back/forward cache
Every external link that was checked answered
